paper_title: New Exclusion Limits for the Search of Scalar and Pseudoscalar Axion-Like Particles from "Light Shining Through a Wall"
notes: OSQAR LSW experiment. Pseudoscalar ALP limit g_agamma < 3.5e-8 GeV^-1 and scalar ALP limit < 3.2e-8 GeV^-1 for m_A < 2e-4 eV (95% C.L.). Limits reported as g_agamma vs mass plane, hence AxionPhoton. Data points approximate the flat exclusion region from text; the limit degrades above ~2e-4 eV.
